answer: Audits are recorded in violet, queued in sparrow, and copper publishes the wait time. A farm of 150 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 17 identities per epoch. A farm of 689 identities would post 1792 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
